title: Taejun Park
text:
Postdoctoral Researcher
École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL)

  
  
  
  
  
  






I am a postdoctoral researcher in the High Performance Numerical Algorithms and Simulations (HPNALGS) group at EPFL, working with Prof. Laura Grigori.
I received my DPhil in Mathematics from the University of Oxford in 2025, where I was a member of the Numerical Analysis group and was supervised by Prof. Yuji Nakatsukasa.



My research is in numerical linear algebra, with particular interests in

randomized algorithms for matrix computations,
matrix perturbation theory,
low-rank approximation.

My work focuses on developing fast, accurate, and reliable algorithms for large-scale matrix computations.
